description: This file is a PHP unit test class for the CandidateOfferDecliningAPI in the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It contains test methods for API endpoints related to declining a candidate's offer, including tests for the 'getOne', 'getValidationRuleForGetOne', 'update', 'delete', and 'getValidationRuleForDelete' methods.
